title: Information Technology Business Analyst
description:
Our client is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Business Analyst to join their team. The ideal candidate will play a key role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions by gathering requirements, defining acceptance criteria, and ensuring seamless collaboration between stakeholders and development teams. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful software initiatives within a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities:
Gather, document, and analyze business requirements for software development projects. Define clear and actionable acceptance criteria for front-end, back-end, and integration workflows. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure requirements are accurately translated into technical solutions. Manage and prioritize user stories, tasks, and epics using Jira. Facilitate requirement clarification sessions and stakeholder discussions to align expectations. Perform gap analysis and recommend improvements for business processes and system integrations. Support development and QA teams to ensure deliverables meet acceptance criteria. Assist during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and help resolve issues or discrepancies. Communicate progress updates, risks, and milestones to internal and external stakeholders. Required Skills and Qualifications:
Proven experience writing detailed software acceptance criteria for complex systems. Strong hands-on experience with Jira (epics, user stories, task management, workflows). Solid understanding of front-end UX principles, back-end logic, and system integrations. Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and fast-paced environment. High attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Preferred Qualifications:
Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies. Familiarity with modern software development practices and integration tools.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Floorplan-To-3d Automation)
description: About Formify Formify is building the future of digital manufacturing for interior spaces --- from online 3D configuration to ready-to-machine outputs for kitchens, closets, and bathrooms. As part of our roadmap, we're developing AI tools that convert floorplans into 3D layouts to accelerate design, quoting, and production workflows. Your Role We're seeking an AI/ML Engineer to lead the development of a system that can analyze floorplan images (PDFs, DWGs, etc.) and convert them into 3D geometry --- walls, doors, windows, and more --- ready for our CPQ engine. You'll develop core AI capabilities and work closely with our design automation and backend teams to bring intelligent layout recognition to life. What You'll Do Design and train deep learning models to extract spatial and semantic information from 2D floorplans (images or vector files). Develop pipelines to convert detected geometry into structured 3D models (e.G., wall objects, door/window placement). Work with vector data (DXF/DWG), PDFs, or raster images to detect key architectural features. Collaborate with CAD and backend engineers to translate AI output into parametric geometry. Optimize models for speed, accuracy, and usability in real-world production environments. Create optimal cabinetry layouts and suggestions from data provided from designers. Experience Levels Mid-Level (3-6 years experience) Strong experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and vision models (YOLO, UNet, Detectron, etc.) Experience in computer vision or document/image parsing Understanding of geometry-based learning and spatial context Ability to translate model output into geometric representations Senior Level (6+ years experience) Advanced expertise in geometry-based learning, OCR with spatial context, and complex vision systems Proven ability to lead ML projects from conception to production Experience with CAD/BIM environments, Rhino/Grasshopper, or geometry processing libraries (e.G., trimesh, Open3D) Track record of deploying ML models in real-world manufacturing or design environments Project leadership and team mentoring experience Bonus Experience Experience with CAD/BIM environments, Rhino/Grasshopper, or geometry processing libraries Knowledge of architectural drawing standards and conventions Experience in manufacturing or design automation industries Why You'll Love This You'll work at the bleeding edge of vision + design automation. Your work will drastically reduce the time from inspiration to production in the interiors industry. Join a cross-functional team where AI connects directly to real-world manufacturing. Competitive compensation with opportunity to pioneer AI applications in manufacturing.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist (Phd) - 34877
description:
About Turing:
Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways:
Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview:
In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and english comprehension skills The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in mathematics, particularly at the level expected in engineering entrance exams, as well as graduate or PhD-level programs. You should be able to break down complex mathematical concepts into simple, clear explanations and work efficiently. The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:
Design and solve challenging math problems to probe the limitations of large language models. Develop high-quality, step-by-step solutions with clear and rigorous reasoning. Collaborate with LLM researchers to align problem types with evaluation goals, particularly in areas where models commonly struggle (e.G., abstraction, multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation). Contribute to defining new evaluation benchmarks based on Mathematics curricula spanning early undergraduate to PhD-level topics. Requirements:
Analytical Skills:
Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills:
Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking:
Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication:
Excellent structured communication and collaboration skills in a remote setting. Independence:
Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup:
Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications:
Candidates pursuing a Ph.D./Postdoctoral degree in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field are eligible and encouraged to apply. Ability to analyze and solve complex math problems with a structured and logical approach. Ability to explain math concepts clearly using simple language, visuals, and examples. title: Senior Backend (Llm) Engineer
description:
About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation. About The Role You’ll be designing and optimizing AI models, fine-tuning LLMs, OCR, and other AI-driven systems to streamline complex workflows and make insurance automation smarter, faster, and more reliable. This isn’t just another ML role. We’re solving deep-rooted inefficiencies that insurance agencies have struggled with for decades—so much so that prospects have nearly teared up realizing how much time and effort our solutions will save them. Your work won’t be theoretical—it will directly transform the way thousands of businesses operate. What You’ll Do:
Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. Design and optimize workflows for AI-driven customer interactions with the help of integration and fine tuning LLMs. Prepare datasets for LLM fine-tuning. Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2 years of expertise in TypeScript/Node.Js. Deep understanding of microservices architecture and cloud-based deployment (AWS, Heroku). Deep understanding of Postgres database architecture and design. Proven experience with scalable API design and database optimization. Experience in fine-tuning and integration with LLMs (ChatGPT, ClaudeAI, Llama, etc.) Experience in gathering datasets for LLM fine-tuning. Passion for writing clean, maintainable, and testable code. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. A collaborative mindset with a willingness to mentor and learn from others. What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment. Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons. You’ll have the opportunity to specialize in:
AI Agents – The core of our automation strategy, building AI-driven workflows that replace tedious, manual processes with seamless decision-making LLM & Model Fine-Tuning – Adapting models to understand and process insurance-specific language and workflows with high accuracy OCR & Document Intelligence – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing critical insights from a wide range of insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Training models to aggregate, categorize, and link scattered data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Why Join XILO? A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Real-world data at scale – Work with rich, high-quality datasets collected from hundreds of insurance agencies, providing a strong foundation for AI fine- tuning, automation, and decision-making models

Our number one goal is to create a work environment that lifts people up, helps develop them, and creates an environment that empowers people to perform at their best.By focusing on our people first, our goal is enabling our team to 100% focus on our clients and the services we provide them all geared towards helping small businesses scale across the US.With this mindset,Hite Digitalhas found themselves managing over 1M in marketing funds per year in just 4 months bringing on at least 2 new team members each month.What is the role of a Digital Marketing Engineer @Hite Digital?We call this role the brains of what we do at Hite Digital because our client's success or failure will boil down to how you manage the accounts, from setting up a great foundation to optimizing properly.This position will manage up to 40 clients across different marketing channels like Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads, among others. provides suggestions on website or landing page content that may help drive campaign conversion rates, including suggestions for offers, promotions, and user experience enhancements. coordinates with Account Managers, Web Designers, and Account Managers to provide the best client experience possible. description:
OysterLink is the newest and fastest-growing restaurant & hospitality job site. The site just launched recently and is generating over 300,000 monthly visitors organically. Our goal is to generate millions of monthly visitors organically within two years' time. We are seeking a forward-facing & true Digital Marketing Expert with creative thinking, hands-on expertise, and excellent English communication with the following skills :
Effectively analyze Analytics Strong hands-on expertise in at least 3 digital marketing channels Ability to create compelling and engaging copy for marketing campaigns Increase the brand awareness, engagement, and conversions Create and implement an effective strategy to target recruiters to post jobs & candidates to apply to jobs Effective use of AI to streamline tasks and improve results The Goals for this position are to achieve the following:
Generate 100 job postings monthly, listed on the site within 2 months 500 job postings monthly listed within 6 months 1000 job postings monthly listed within 12 months The majority of jobs should get their first applicant within 1 business day Required Skills:
Excellent English speaking and writing skills Strong copywriting skills 7+ years of digital marketing experience and expertise in at least 3 online marketing channels Proven ability to use AI effectively to streamline and enhance marketing results Proven ability to lead and grow marketing teams Proven track record of growing brands online, by showcasing previous results Ideation-driven and proven ability to create strategies to ensure goals are met OysterLink offers competitive salaries, yearly growth opportunities AND company shares for all team members. This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position as our headquarters are in the US. As our clients are in the US, we do require team members who can work up until 3 pm EST. What we offer at OysterLink:
A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth Competitive pay and scheduled yearly raises Shares in the company to receive earn out when the company is sold Challenging projects and opportunities to work with great team members Work-from-home opportunity 4 weeks paid time off We are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires. Começamos com uma loja na Rua do Gasômetro e, com muito trabalho e inovação, nos tornamos a maior distribuidora de produtos e serviços do segmento. Crescemos junto aos nossos clientes. Hoje, estamos presentes em mais de 120 lojas pelo Brasil e no Paraguai, com um Centro de Distribuição e sede administrativa em Barueri-SP. Estamos sempre onde nossos clientes precisam, oferecendo soluções completas e impulsionando o setor a cada passo. Nosso compromisso vai além dos negócios. Acreditamos no impacto que geramos e na força da nossa cultura:
Fortes:
Nossa força está no impacto que geramos. Agimos para manter nossa competitividade e gerar resultados duradouros para as pessoas, a sociedade e o planeta. Colocamos o cliente no centro de tudo, fomentamos a inovação e enfrentamos desafios com garra e resiliência, sem fugir das conversas que realmente importam. Simples:
Agimos com alegria, humildade e leveza. Cultivamos relações de confiança, valorizamos a transparência e o respeito. Reconhecemos nossas limitações e buscamos aprendizado contínuo. Acreditamos em soluções simples e criativas, com o básico bem feito como princípio. Juntos:
Sozinhos vamos rápido, juntos vamos mais longe. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa, pois acreditamos que juntos somos mais fortes. Reconhecemos que o sucesso é coletivo, não individual. Colocamos a mão na massa, promovemos a troca de ideias e aprendemos com os erros. E, ao longo da jornada, celebramos juntos cada conquista. Nosso propósito:
Contribuir para o sucesso do setor da marcenaria. Ambição:
Criar um ecossistema completo para ser o one-stop shop do mundo da marcenaria, resolvendo as necessidades de forma simples e criando espaços mais belos e funcionais. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista De Métricas De Software Pleno
description:
Visão geral A TIVIT é uma multinacional brasileira e one-stop-shop de tecnologia, presente no mercado há 20 anos e com operação em dez países da América Latina. Por meio de quatro unidades de negócios:
Digital Business, Cloud Solutions, CyberSecurity e Technology Platforms, a empresa oferece respostas personalizadas e soluções que impactam nos negócios, e na rotina de empresas e pessoas. Responsabilidades e atribuições Analista de Ponto de Função é um profissional que trabalha com a medição da produtividade no desenvolvimento de software, utilizando a técnica de Ponto de Função (Function Point Analysis - FPA). Principais Responsabilidades:
Medição de Software com Ponto de Função:
Realizar a medição de projetos de software utilizando a técnica de Ponto de Função. Isso envolve identificar as funcionalidades que o sistema oferece e atribuir valores a essas funcionalidades para calcular o tamanho do sistema em Ponto de Função. Análise de Produtividade:
Medir e acompanhar a produtividade das equipes de desenvolvimento de software com base no número de Pontos de Função entregues por unidade de tempo, como horas ou dias de trabalho. Isso ajuda a avaliar o desempenho e eficiência das equipes de desenvolvimento. Estimativas de Esforço e Custo:
Utilizar os Pontos de Função para ajudar na estimativa do esforço necessário para completar um projeto ou tarefa, além de contribuir com a estimativa de custo e prazo de entrega de um sistema. Desenvolvimento de Relatórios de Produtividade:
Criar relatórios periódicos e dashboards que mostram a produtividade da equipe de desenvolvimento, o andamento dos projetos e a evolução ao longo do tempo. Comparação de Desempenho:
Comparar a produtividade de diferentes projetos, equipes ou períodos, analisando as variações nos Pontos de Função e fazendo recomendações de melhorias quando necessário. Controle de Qualidade de Métricas:
Garantir que as medições de Ponto de Função sejam precisas, consistentes e realizadas conforme as melhores práticas da técnica, evitando erros ou distorções nos dados de produtividade. Apoio ao Planejamento de Projetos:
Fornece informações sobre a complexidade e o tamanho dos projetos de software com base nos Pontos de Função, para que os gestores possam planejar recursos, cronogramas e orçamento de forma mais eficaz. Análise de Desempenho Histórico:
Analisar a produtividade histórica das equipes ou de projetos anteriores, ajudando a identificar tendências e áreas onde a produtividade pode ser melhorada. Melhoria Contínua:

title: Ai Agent Engineer
description:
About XILO:
Founded in 2019 by two best friends—Jon, a software engineer, and Eli, an insurance brokerage owner—XILO is a Vertical AI company transforming the insurance industry from the inside out. Initially a SaaS platform to streamline quoting, XILO is now building the future of insurance operations using AI Agents.We’ve recently closed our Series A from top-tier investors and are growing quickly. Our mission is to automate the marketing, sales, and service workflows of insurance agencies with AI Agents that do the work—start to finish.About the Role:
We’re looking for an AI Agent Engineer who has built real AI agents that execute complex, multi-step workflows in production environments (or locally).You’ve gone beyond basic prompt engineering and RAG—you’ve designed stateful agents, handled tool-calling, memory, routing, and orchestrated agents using LangGraph, OpenAI SDK, SmolAgent, or similar frameworks.In this role, you’ll own the architecture, design, and implementation of AI Agents that interact with third-party systems (web apps, APIs, documents) to complete insurance workflows autonomously. You’ll partner with founders, product, and engineering to take agents from prototype to production—and ensure they’re resilient, auditable, and accurate.Key Responsibilities:
Design and implement multi-step AI Agents using agentic frameworks(LangGraph, OpenAI SDK/Swarm, Google ADK, etc.).Architect robust workflows for agents that interact with browser automation, APIs, LLMs, PDFs, and CRMs.Optimize latency, cost, and performance across the agent lifecycle.Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate agents into our core platform.Create strong observability and debugging tools to ensure agent performance and accountability.Handle prompt engineering, function-calling, memory, tool creation, and multi-agent orchestration.Stay on the frontier of agent research and apply new findings pragmatically.You Might Be a Fit If:
You’ve shipped agent-based systems that go beyond chat UX—e.G., agents that fill forms, move through websites, analyze documents, or trigger downstream workflows.You’re fluent in one or more of the agentic frameworks:
LangGraph, SmolAgent, OpenAI SDK, Google ADK, CrewAI, etc.You are an excellent backend engineer who codes daily and owns systems end to end.You’re obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave deterministically when needed.You’ve worked with LLMs via API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Mistral, or fine-tuned models).You understand when to use LLMs vs deterministic logic and how to blend both.You’re deeply organized, low ego, and can lead through action and collaboration.You care about product and user value just as much as the tech stack.Bonus Points:
Experience with RPA, Selenium, or building automation bots for web workflows.Background in insurance, fintech, or other compliance-heavy verticals. Contributions to open-source agentic frameworks or related tooling.Knowledge of DevOps and production monitoring for AI services.What We Offer:
Collaborative and innovative work environmentFlex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.Personal laptop.Health and wellness package.Budget for English lessons.Why Join XILO?You’ll be on the ground floor of a rapidly growing AI startup building AI agents that replace jobs, not just enhance them. You’ll solve real business problems, help agents generate revenue and reduce service costs, and leave your fingerprint on the core intelligence of our product.We’re a mission-driven team that works hard, moves fast, and doesn’t stop until the job is done right. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, we want to hear from you.Apply only if you’re ready to build AI that does the job—not just chat about it.

title: Senior Project Manager (Software Development)
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English Job Title:
Senior Project Manager (Software Development) Type:
Full-Time or Part-time Position Summary:
LOGIC Solutions Group is seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager to lead and manage projects with teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts in the geospatial information technology area. The ideal candidate will possess outstanding client communication skills, strong leadership capabilities, a deep understanding of Agile methodologies, and PMP certification. Additionally, the role requires hands-on experience managing projects through Microsoft DevOps, focusing on the effective organization and tracking of user stories, epics, sprints, and other Agile artifacts. The ability to perform business analysis as needed is also essential, ensuring that projects align with business and technical objectives. Key Responsibilities:
Leadership & Team Management:
Lead and manage cross-functional teams, including Technical Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts, ensuring high performance and alignment with project goals. Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. Oversee the team's daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed on time and within scope. Project Management:
Develop, maintain, and execute detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Manage multiple projects simultaneously, with a focus on application/software development. Own and facilitate project status meetings, adjusting project targets and schedules as needed. Microsoft DevOps Project Management:
Manage and configure sprints, backlogs, and work items within Microsoft DevOps to ensure project transparency and alignment with Agile methodologies. Track and manage user stories and epics, ensuring they are well-defined, prioritized, and aligned with project goals. Facilitate daily stand-ups (scrums), sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives to ensure team collaboration and continuous improvement. Monitor and manage burndown charts and other Agile metrics to track project progress and ensure timely delivery. Collaborate with team members to ensure DevOps practices support efficient project execution and align with client needs. Business Analysis:
Perform business analysis tasks on projects as needed, including requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder interviews. Ensure business requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to technical teams. Client Engagement:
Serve as clients' primary point of contact, ensuring their needs and expectations are met. Communicate project progress, risks, and issues effectively to clients and stakeholders. Ensure client satisfaction by delivering projects that meet or exceed their requirements. Technical Oversight:
Collaborate with Technical Architects to ensure project designs align with business objectives and technical standards. Review and approve technical and business documentation, ensuring completeness and accuracy. Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies to provide strategic technical direction. Quality Assurance & Risk Management:
Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet the required standards. Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring proactive solutions to potential challenges. Required Skills & Experience:
Fluent English Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a closely related field. Minimum of 8 years of IT Project Management experience in an Agile (Scrum) environment, with a strong focus on application/software development. PMP certification is required. Proven track record of managing teams of Technical Architects, Developers, QA professionals, and Business Analysts. Hands-on experience with Microsoft DevOps, particularly in managing user stories, epics, sprints, and Agile metrics such as burndown charts. Ability to perform business analysis on projects, including requirements gathering and process documentation. Experience managing project budgets of over $1M and delivering projects on time and within scope. Hands-on experience overseeing all phases of the SDLC, from requirements gathering to deployment. Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Strong leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams. Strong organization skills and mindset. Desired Skills & Qualifications:
Experience in the Oil and Gas industry is highly desirable. Experience with geospatial technologies is a plus. Previous experience in a consulting role or possessing a consultative mindset. Prior hands-on development or coding experience is a plus. Other:
The role offers a dynamic work environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies and solutions. The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Informations:

title: Gerente Produto | Linha Amarela
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m². Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:
2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país. Como nosso Gerente de Produto, você irá:
Prospectar oportunidades comerciais para vendas de equipamentos de Linha Amarela;
Atuar na gestão, planejamento, controle e administração das estratégias, políticas, programas e regras estabelecidas para sua conta ou contas. Gerencia a carteira de clientes estratégicos da área de linha amarela;
Promover ações e eventos de marketing para os principais stakeholders;
Atuar junto com a equipe de engenharia para comparação e efetividade dos equipamentos;
Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:
Forte experiência desenvolvimento de comunicação do produto;
Conhecimento com gestão de peças e serviços;
Ter carteira de clientes no seguimento de linha amarela;
Inglês Avançado (Desejável);
Graduação completa em Engenharia ou áreas a fins. Regiões de Atendimento GO, BA, CE, MA. Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:
Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Seguro de Vida Refeição no Local Transporte Crédito Consignado Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Senior Business Analyst - Digital Bss
description:
If digital transformation, next generation technology and growth opportunities excite you, then apply to join our Netcracker Technology Team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams, earn a competitive salary and contribute to the largest digital transformations happening around the world. What is in it for you? At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly. What is the scope of this role? Netcracker Technology is looking to hire a Business Analyst to join our Implementation Engineering teams located throughout the LATAM region. As a CRM/BSS Domain technological subject matter expert (SME), you will be responsible for leading a team providing cost-effective solutions to business and technical challenges faced in large/complex Telecommunications projects. Business Analysts are working as a company’s representatives in front of the enterprise customer. You will be responsible for defining and documenting measurable criteria for solution assessment, proposing solutions, and bringing best practices. It is expected that you will have recognition in the Telecommunications industry as a CRM or BSS Domain SME. What will be your responsibilities? The key element of the role is focused on analysis and project design, which can be delivered through the baseline capabilities of existing products. Most importantly - stakeholder management as well as expectation management. Collecting and collating business requirements for Business-to-Business telecom products on various network technologies. Guiding and coaching the business stakeholders through the requirements gathering process. Providing clarification and acting as a point of reference for business requirement inquiries by solution design and project delivery teams. Working with project teams to agree on an approach and keep them informed of progress. Facilitating workshops required to understand and document detailed requirements and solution behavior. Working closely with the delivery team to ensure functional and non-functional completeness of the solution. Creating comprehensive and unambiguous documentation that outlines the requirements of stakeholders, traceable for the testing team and understandable for the development team. Developing comprehensive knowledge of the aligned business area and the trust of its business stakeholders. What skills and experience will you need for this role? Minimum 7+ years of sufficient technical knowledge to understand high-level architecture and technical requirements around BSS/CRM solutions for Telecom projects. Experience with next-gen CRM and Converged Billing applications (CPQ, Order Management, Product Catalog, etc). Strong business analysis background, preferably in an internet/software development company. Organizational skills, able to work simultaneously on a number of assignments when required. Knowledge of business analysis principles and methodologies. Proven ability to work BSS/CRM functionally to drive the accurate capture of requirements, resolving and closing down issues and information shortfall as they appear. Experience of working within Waterfall & Agile methodology. Ability to collaborate and solve challenges. Proven experience of successfully working within transformation projects, or projects with B2B products. Previous experience leading architecture teams. Fluent in English and Portuguese languages. Availability to work from the office in a Hybrid mode (at least 3 times per week). Education:

Coordenar o trabalho em parceria com o time de Data Science para projetar e implementar soluções baseadas em dados e Machine Learning. Governança e segurança:
Garantir boas práticas de proteção de dados, controle de acessos, auditoria e conformidade com regulamentos como LGPD e GDPR. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:
Liderança técnica:
Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica de projetos de engenharia de dados, com habilidade para orientar e desenvolver profissionais tecnicamente. Expertise em engenharia de dados:
Domínio avançado de tecnologias e conceitos de engenharia de dados, incluindo SQL, bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais, e ferramentas de processamento de dados em larga escala. Cloud Computing:
Experiência sólida com provedores de nuvem, especialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e seus serviços como BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Dataflow e Cloud Storage. Programação:
Forte conhecimento em Python e frameworks de processamento de dados (PySpark, Pandas, Dask). Visualização de dados:
Experiência com ferramentas de visualização como Looker Studio, Power BI ou Tableau para transformar dados em insights visuais. Orquestração de dados:
Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração como Apache Airflow para gerenciar workflows de dados. DevOps para dados:
Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD para pipelines de dados, infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e automação de processos de dados. Metodologias ágeis:
Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) aplicadas a projetos de dados. Comunicação:
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos para diferentes públicos. Mentoria:
Capacidade de fornecer feedbacks construtivos e orientar tecnicamente outros profissionais. Arquitetura de software:
Capacidade de compreender arquiteturas de software e sistemas distribuídos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e escalabilidade. SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:
Experiência com ferramentas de Data Science, incluindo bibliotecas e frameworks para modelagem e análise de dados. Conhecimento em sistemas ERP, especialmente TOTVS, em contextos de integração de dados corporativos. Certificações em cloud e dados, como Google Cloud Certified – Professional Data Engineer. Experiência com Data Mesh e arquiteturas modernas de plataformas de dados. Experiência avançada em ferramentas de Business Intelligence e desenvolvimento de dashboards analíticos. Experiência com governança de dados e implementação de estratégias de qualidade de dados em escala. INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa:
aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média. A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados. E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente. Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma. interacting daily with C level executives. Impact :

You'll collaborate closely with frontend, product, and our AI/ML teams, gaining exposure to how backend systems power intelligent applications and exploring ways AI can enhance development velocity and system performance. Remote, Brazil About BeyondRisk AI-6 BeyondRisk empowers organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale AI-driven solutions through our AI-6 platform. We seamlessly bring together smart agents, data, and automation so enterprises can solve their toughest challenges at speed. Key Responsibilities Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and applications primarily using Java (Spring Boot). Create well-documented, reliable, and performant RESTful APIs using standards like OpenAPI/Swagger. Design and implement backend systems capable of efficiently serving, monitoring, and interacting with machine learning models and AI workflows. Design data models and manage interactions with databases like PostgreSQL. Explore and leverage modern development practices, potentially including AI-assisted tooling, to accelerate the delivery of high-quality code and enhance system observability. Work effectively with frontend engineers, AI/ML specialists, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver cohesive solutions. Champion high-quality code, perform code reviews, and advocate for engineering best practices. You’ll Excel in This Role If You:
Have Proven Backend Engineering Experience. Are Proficient in Java:
Strong programming skills in Java (ideally with Spring Boot) for backend development. Embrace Cloud Technologies:

Thrive in a team environment, enjoy tackling complex technical challenges, and communicate effectively. Focus on Quality & Scalability:
Understand the importance of writing clean, testable, maintainable code and building systems that scale. Adapt Quickly:

Strong proficiency with Java (Spring Boot) for backend development. Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs, with knowledge of OpenAPI/Swagger. Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred). Experience with microservices architecture is a plus. Why Join BeyondRisk Compensation & Equity:
Competitive salary + stock options. High-Impact Role:
Directly contribute to the core platform powering BeyondRisk’s success globally. Cutting-Edge AI Platform:
Work on the backend systems of a next-gen hyper-automation solution transforming enterprises. Culture & Learning:
A culture of continuous learning, technical excellence, and close collaboration between engineering and AI/ML teams. Global Collaboration:
Thrive in a dynamic, international environment, working closely with talented colleagues across the US, Europe, and Asia. Fast-Paced Growth:

Shape the future of AI – be at the forefront of enterprise innovation by building the technology that enables it. Ready to Build the Future of AI? title: It Analyst
description:
*Remote Opportunity!**Please attach your resume/CV in English;
only those will be considered.About us:
Let's Live Better!Vive Health is a growing company specializing in providing high-quality and affordable medical equipment. We strive to separate from the pack and become your trustworthy and affordable online medical equipment store;
providing products thatyou’d be proud to use yourself, and give to your loved ones or patients.At Vive Health, we are dedicated to enhancing the lives of our customers. Our focus is on supporting individuals recovering from injuries, managing their health, or caring for loved ones. We strive to empower them with the tools and resources they need to feel confident and in control of their well-being.We are committed to helping you live better. As a Top 50 Amazon seller in the USA, we have designed and developed multiple specialty brands to demonstrate our commitment to supplying you with the very best product options.About the role:
We’re looking for a collaborative, detail-oriented Systems Analyst who will be our frontline for IT incidents and small change requests while helping shepherd projects from kickoff to close-out. You’ll start in a combined Level I/II capacity—handling day-to-day tickets, chasing down root causes, and making light code tweaks—then grow into documenting new and existing projects, coordinating with sponsors, stakeholders and external developers, and verifying delivered work. Your primary mission:
keep our systems (especially Odoo ERP) reliable, secure and continuously improving so the business can move fast with confidenceWho you are / What you bring:
Problem-Solver:
You break problems into pieces, test hypotheses quickly, and don’t quit until there’s a clear root cause. Code-Conversant:
Comfortable reading Python and Bash;
you can tweak scripts,review pull requests and speak the developers’ language. Organized Communicator:
You juggle multiple threads without dropping the ball, and you translate technical findings into plain English for sponsors and stakeholders. Continuous Learner:
New technology, framework or API? You’re the first to spin up a sandbox and see how it works.Responsibilities include:
Serve as the first-line (Level I/II) contact for IT incidents—diagnose, resolve or escalate within agreed SLAs. Provide day-to-day systems support to end users, ensuring timely, effective issue resolution. Track and coordinate multiple small projects simultaneously, keeping sponsors and stakeholders informed with clear status updates. Review developer pull requests/commits and perform light Python or Bash tweaks when needed. Verify delivered features against requirements;
log and follow up on defects or improvement ideas. Investigate and troubleshoot Odoo ERP workflows, modules and performance issues;
propose actionable fixes. Identify and drive opportunities to streamline processes, harden security and improve service quality. Create, update and maintain runbooks, SOPs, diagrams and change logs for consistent knowledge sharing. Provide training and guidance to users through documentation, quick huddles and recorded demos. Assist in maintaining and enhancing company-wide security controls (identity, endpoint, backups, MFA) and support QA/compliance activities.Qualifications:
Experience working with ERP/CRM systems (Odoo) in a technical role. Experience working in IT-related positions and Project Management. Knowledge of basic L1-L3 networking principles. Familiarity with Quality Assurance processes. Knowledge of and proven experience on Python programming language and Bash. Proficient in written and spoken English. Competent in managing and using Virtual Workspace Environments (e.G., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office 365, Dialpad) - Nice to HaveOur Mission:
More Info On Our Products and Services:
Our website at to learn more.

verify fixes and prevent regressions. CI/CD Quality Gates:

block faulty builds andsurface metrics. Scripting & Tooling:

Solid grounding in functional, regression, and integration testing methodologies. Automate Relentlessly:
Hands-on with Selenium, Cypress, Postman/Newman, or equivalent frameworks. Speak API Fluently:
Confident validating request/response payloads, headers, auth flows, and error handling. Track & Triage Like a Pro:
Comfortable creating clear, actionable Jira tickets that engineers love (and fear). Think in Pipelines:
Understand how QA fits into DevOps;
you wire tests into CIand keep the build clean. Code Just Enough:

Experience using LLMs or AI tools to auto-generate test cases, data, or scripts. Why Join BeyondRisk Compensation & Equity:
Competitive salary + stock options. High-Impact Role:
Directly shape the user experience of a cutting-edge AI platform used by global enterprises. Cutting-Edge AI Platform:
Work on the frontend interfaces for a next-gen hyper-automation solution transforming enterprises. Culture & Learning:
A culture of continuous learning, technical excellence, and close collaboration between engineering and AI/ML teams. Global Collaboration:
Thrive in a dynamic, international environment, working closely with talented colleagues across the US, Europe, and Asia. Fast-Paced Growth:

Shape the future of AI – be at the forefront of enterprise innovation by building the technology that enables it. Ready to Break Things (Before Users Do)? Apply now with an up-to-date CV (PDF). Let’s build trustworthy AI together.

description:
Atribuições:
Garantir os procedimentos de recebimento previstos para cada matéria-prima, material de embalagem e peças de manutenção, bem como inspecionar os veículos antes do início do descarregamento através do preenchimento de check list;
Executar inventários cíclicos e dinâmicos, de acordo com os procedimentos e cronograma pré-estabelecidos, garantindo a qualidade das informações e acuracidade dos estoques de insumos e peças de manutenção;
Garantir a organização dos produtos na área de armazenagem de acordo com o FEFO (PRIMEIRO QUE EXPIRA X PRIMEIRO QUE SAI);
Apoiar no direcionamento das atividades para a rotina de abastecimento da produção com matérias-primas e materiais de embalagem especificadas e sanitariamente íntegros de acordo com o plano de produção definido;
Garantir a correta identificação dos pallets de produtos no ato do recebimento, conforme procedimento definido;
Manter a área de trabalho organizada e limpa seguindo o conceito de 5S a fim de assegurar o atendimento às normas regulatórias;
Fazer lançamentos dasmovimentações de entradas e saídas de notas fiscais e requisições diversas nos sistemas de controle da Empresa (Exemplo:
Oracle Cloud, RI, RECEIVER);
Manter atualizadas asplanilhas de controle do setor, report diário via e-mail das informações necessárias para bom andamento das atividades operacionais;
Preencher as planilhas de controles do setor, as mantendo sempre atualizadas e organizadas;
Operar os equipamentos de movimentação, com segurança, garantindo a integridade do equipamento bem como do bem material da empresa evitando risco de acidente de acordo com as especificações técnicas. Requisitos Necessários:
Ensino médio completo Pacote Office intermediário Habilitação Categoria B Curso de Operador de Empilhadeira devidamente registrado dentro do prazo de validade Experiência profissional em função similar.

Caso você seja uma pessoa que age como dono para enfrentar desafios, se adapta à novas tecnologias, se preocupa com o próximo, e entrega trabalhos excelentes, temos um lugar especial para você!Somos uma multinacional do ramo do Agronegócio em fase de expansão, com ótimas oportunidades de carreira.Sua Missão será administrar a demanda de Gerente Executivo Financeiro.Garantir a execução da estratégia do capital financeiro dentro da organização alinhada com a tesouraria global do grupo Indorama, visando a geração de valor e a mitigação de riscos.Responsabilidades:
Gestão do Caixa e Investimentos:
Garantir a execução e a acuracidade das informações através dos relatórios financeiros;
garantir a remuneraçãodos recursos excedentes, a fim de rentabilizar ao máximo o capital disponível com o menor risco.Gestão de Moeda Estrangeira (FX):
Garantir o cumprimento da política de proteção cambial da companhia, e dos pagamentos em moeda estrangeira, através de uma gestão ativa e com acompanhamento de indicadores financeiros.Gestão de Financiamento e Capital de Giro:
Alcançar a estrutura de capital para a companhia, através de uma gestão financeira ativa, interagindo com os stakeholders da companhia, a fim de entender os principais drivers de capital de giro e garantir a captação de recursos necessários para os cumprimentos das obrigações financeiras.Gestão de Relacionamentos Bancários:
Desenvolver e administrar o relacionamento com instituições financeiras a fim de garantir o acesso à capital de baixo custo, visando a maximização da rentabilidade da companhia e o bom funcionamento operacional da tesouraria através das contas bancárias.Gestão de Risco:
Garantir a execução e manutenção das políticas de risco da companhia, através de revisões periódicas com os principais stakeholders, a fim de mapear e mitigar potenciais riscos para a companhia.Requisitos:
Ensino Superior Completo em Contabilidade, Economia ou Administração;
Desejável Pós-Graduaçãoem Finanças ou áreas correlatas;
Conhecimento emmercadosde capitais e contabilidade, análise e elaboração de fluxo de caixa, criar, analisar e projetar cenários, avaliar e elaborar modelagens financeiras;
Inglês Fluente;
Pacote Office Avançado.Benefícios:
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica sem custo para o titular e mensalidade para dependentes;
Cartão refeição;
Cartão alimentação;
Seguro de vida em grupopela empresa;
PLR Sindical;
Vale transporte;
Programas de desenvolvimento;
Programa de bônus, conforme política vigente;
Parceria com o SESI;
TotalPass e Optum.#J-18808-Ljbffr

Issue Resolution & Support Collaboration

Coordinate customer feedback and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Torizon experience.

Solid understanding of embedded Linux environments, device deployment pipelines, or container-based systems (e.G., Docker).

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a customer-first mindset.

Highly organized with a proactive and problem-solving attitude.

additional languages (especially German) are a plus.

title: Coordenador(A) De Logística Hospitalar / Hub Vera Cruz
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade, e ponto Atendimento 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades e ter Acreditação ONA 3 e em jornada de preparação JCI.
Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde, a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.
Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.
A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.
Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

description:
Inclusão e respeito à diversidade e equidade fazem parte do DNA da KPMG.

Aqui valorizamos todas as pessoas, encorajando e empoderando os nossos profissionais para que se sintam parte das nossas conquistas.

Independente da sua idade, gênero, raça, cor, credo, orientação, sexual, etnia, origem nacional ou deficiência, te convidamos a fazer a diferença. Venha fazer parte do time KPMG!

Vaga destinada à KPMG Auditores Independentes LTDA.

A estrutura de Auditoria baseia-se nos princípios essenciais relacionados à integridade profissional, a independência e ao comportamento ético que todos os sócios e membros da equipe precisam apresentar.

A auditoriaé desenvolvida por um conjunto estabelecido de normas e tecnologias de supervisão, análise e consulta e por ferramentas que auxiliam as equipes a acessar conhecimentos – inclusive as técnicas de auditoria computadorizadas exclusivas da KPMG –, tudo projetado para ajudar as equipes a se concentrarem em questões que exercem impacto sobre as decisões de auditoria e para aprimorar sua efetividade e eficiência.

- Fazemos o que é certo #Integrity

- Aprendemos e nos aprimoramos #Excellence

- Pensamos e agimos de maneira arrojada #Courage

- Respeitamos uns aos outros e nos e nos fortalecemos com nossas diferenças #Together

- Fazemos o que realmente importa #For Better

Caso seja aprovado(a), você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Executar operações de auditoria externa em processos contábeis e controles internos;
  • Auditar os procedimentos envolvidos, identificando eventuais falhas e avaliando a eficácia dos controles;
  • Realizar validação de demonstrações financeiras e avaliação dos processos, verificando a correta aplicação das normas nos registros e nas demonstrações financeiras;
  • Apontar não conformidades, confecção de relatórios com pareceres e recomendações;
  • Formalizar os papeis de trabalho com qualidade e ceticismo;
  • Revisar os papeis de trabalho da equipe;
  • Ser responsávelpor orientar equipe no cumprimento da metodologia e minimização de riscos de auditoria.

O que procuramos em você?

  • Experiência com auditoria externa, preferencialmente em Big Four.
  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou Administração de Empresas.

Quais as vantagens de ser KPMG?

- Aqui atuamos com as mais novas tecnologias;

- Nossos profissionais são referência no mercado;

- Somos uma das maiores empresas de prestação de serviço do mundo;

Quais benefícios oferecemos?

- Vale Refeição

- Vale Alimentação

- Assistência Médica

- Assistência Odontológica

- Benefício Bem-estar (Academia)

- Seguro de Vida

- Auxílio Creche

- Incentivo a Graduação

- Subsídio de Órgão de Classe

- Brinde Casamento

- Brinde Nascimento

- Licença Maternidade Extendida

- Jornada de Trabalho Flexível

- Incentivo à Idiomas

A KPMG é uma organização global de firmas independentes que prestam serviços profissionais para empresas, governos, startups , agências do setor público, organizações sem fins lucrativos e instituições dos mercados de capitais.. Estamos presentes em 145 países e territórios, com mais de 236 mil sócios e profissionais atuando nas firmas-membro em todo o mundo. No Brasil, somos aproximadamente cinco mil sócios e profissionais. Cada firma-membro KPMG é uma entidade legal independente e separada e descreve-se como tal, sendo responsável jurídica e financeiramente por suas próprias obrigações e por seus próprios atos. Orientada pelo seu propósito de empoderar a mudança, a KPMG empresa é uma organização referência nos segmentos em que atua. Compartilhamos valor e inspiramos confiança no mercado de capitais e nas comunidades há mais de 100 anos, transformando pessoas e empresas e gerando impactos positivos, que contribuem para a realização de mudanças sustentáveis em nossos clientes, governos e sociedade civil.

Prestamos serviços profissionais, baseados em princípios éticos e de excelência, em três áreas:

Auditoria:
Avaliamos e asseguramos as informações geradas por nossos clientes por meio de serviços de auditoria independente, com base em metodologias e tecnologias exclusivas. Dessa forma, contribuímos para a qualidade das informações nas tomadas de decisões.

Impostos:
Ajudamos nossos clientes a cumprirem as demandas tributárias, assim como a se prepararem para responder às demandas de seus negócios, aplicando nosso conhecimento e nossa visão de longo prazo para auxiliá-los a tomar decisões que gerem valor aos seus negócios e à sociedade.

Consultoria:
Apoiamos as decisões estratégicas e o desenvolvimento de projetos das empresas em planejamento estratégico, ESG, fusões e aquisições, gestão de riscos e compliance, melhoria das performances financeira e operacional, transformação dos negócios, inovação e tecnologia, por meio de abordagens multidisciplinares. Também atuamos como provedores de serviços gerenciados.

 Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios .

cidades onde a água potável está vazando, o verde está desaparecendo, as ruas estão inundando após fortes chuvas e sistemas de esgoto desatualizados estão poluindo nossas águas subterrâneas. É hora de fazer parte do nosso time e ajudar a construir ambientes mais sustentáveis!
Estamos atualmente procurando uma Pessoa Vendedora III para se juntar a nós em Campinas - SP. Se você quer fazer a diferença e trabalhar para uma empresa com propósito, verifique os requisitos necessários.
Orbia
A Orbia tem uma equipe global de mais de 24.000 funcionários, atividades comerciais em mais de 100 países e operações em mais de 50, com sedes em Boston, Cidade do México, Amsterdã e Tel Aviv. A empresa gerou US$ 8,2 bilhões em receita em 2023.
AOrbia Building &Infrastructurefaz parte da Orbia uma empresa movida por um propósito comum:
Melhorar a vida ao redor do mundo. A Orbia atua em diversos setores, incluindo:
Soluções em Polímeros (Vestolit e Alphagary),Construção e Infraestrutura(Wavin), Agricultura de Precisão (Netafim), Soluções de Conectividade (Dura-Line) e Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). A Orbia B&I tem 11.000+ funcionários e 65 locais de produção em todo o mundo, atendendo mais de 80 países por meio de uma rede global de vendas e distribuição. Nossas principais marcas comerciais são:
Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin e Bow Wavin.
Como Pessoa Vendedora III Você Vai

    Desempenho de vendas e o cumprimento das exigências legais previstas .

Administração, Engenharia, Marketing, cursos de Tecnólogo em geral.
Você Se Destaca, Se Tiver

Marketing/Vendas.

Quer fazer a diferença trabalhando com um propósito? Aqui assumimos a responsabilidade uns pelos outros e pela nossa empresa. Continuamos corajosos na busca de riscos calculados que alimentam a inovação. E abraçamos a diversidade em perspectivas, habilidades e talentos para transformar a maneira como trabalhamos e o impacto que temos no mundo. Acima de tudo, incentivamos todos os nossos colaboradores a desenvolverem seus talentos e a se tornarem a melhor versão de si mesmos. Juntos, como uma equipe forte, crescemos e cumprimos nosso propósito todos os dias. Orbia B&I é o lugar para estar se você realmente deseja causar um impacto. title: Senior Process Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Process Engineer role at GEA Group

Join to apply for the Senior Process Engineer role at GEA Group

As part of this position, the employee will be involved in the process of preparing offers and providing sales support to drive the company’s business success. Demonstrate competence in understanding customers' objectives and needs and apply our products, systems, technologies, services, and solutions accordingly.
The primary responsibilities will include developing technical solutions, preparing equipment and project budgets, and mainly focusing on creating technical proposals for clients. However, in this position, the employee will also participate in commercial discussions, support the sales team, and assist with project execution activities (manufacturing and installation) as needed.
Responsibilities / Tasks

  • Discuss and present technical solutions to internal and external clients;
  • Develop P&IDs, layouts, technical and commercial offers;
  • Create a list of necessary equipment to request quotes;
  • Request quotations from suppliers and other GEA entities to compose the project's overall solution;
  • Work on projectpricing by carrying out calculations and filling in the cost formation template (advanced knowledge of Excel is desirable);
  • Create a preliminary execution schedule;
  • Carry out a preliminary technical assessment of sales leads and discuss them with the process/application engineering department;
  • Complete technical questionnaires (if applicable) to discuss leads with the group's Competence Centers;
  • Perform technical and commercial evaluations of received bids (RFPs, RFQs, tenders) with support from the application engineering team for technical issues;
  • Execute technical visits to the client (when necessary) to gather technical data for the offer preparation;
  • Participate in technical solution discussions with the GEA Competence Center and request relevant technical calculations, sizing, and information as applicable;
  • Coordinate technical team discussions to define P&IDs and layouts while always considering client demands (knowledge of CAD and VISIO is desirable);
  • Develop a preliminary sales schedule in alignment with the execution team (knowledge of MS Project is desirable);
  • Prepare a risk analysis and mitigation plan, also identifying opportunities;
  • Collaborate with the Sales department to prepare documentation for the Handover Meeting;
  • Prepare, reviewand update documentation and related materials after receiving the client's purchase order (purchase order, sales order, contract, proposals, CRM, among others). Actively participating in understanding and internal transfer of the client’s installation standards, philosophies, and other relevant information;
  • Analyze client feedback, identifying possible Change Orders, and working with the Project Manager;
  • Manage leads and opportunities (knowledge of CRM is desirable);
Your Profile / Qualifications
  • Masters Degree in Food, Chemical, Production Engineering or correlated areas.
  • Proven experience in Beverage / Food Industries and/or equipment and projects companies for this segment.
  • In-depth knowledge of fluid mechanics and thermodynamics is required.
  • Desirable experience in selling industrial equipment and preparing budgets.
  • Advanced English is required.
  • Spanish is a plus.

title: Página Da Vaga | Supervisor De Produtos Financeiros
description:
Job description

#VEMSERCAEDU

Procuramos profissionais que sejam #SoluçãoParaoCliente , #ConfiemColaboremCompartilhem e que tenham #AlegriaEnergiaeAcolhimento !

Atuamos no varejo de moda há 50 anos e estamos presentes nos estados de São Paulo, Rio grande do Sul, Goiás, DF e Minas Gerais com 100 lojas .

Temos um ambiente alegre e acolhedor e o melhor de tudo, com possibilidade de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional!

Se você busca desafios em sua área de atuação, não abre mão de ética e respeito , tem senso de dono e acredita que juntos somos mais fortes , vem para Caedu .

Na Caedu nós trabalhamos com um propósito claro:
Compartilhar o que temos de melhor para vestir histórias mais felizes. Para isso, respeitamos a diversidade, trabalhamos com senso de dono e queremos proporcionar o melhor para os nossos colaboradores e cliente SEMPRE!


Main responsibilities

Quais serão suas atividades?

  • Supervisionar as atividades desenvolvidas pela equipe de produtos e serviços financeiros, garantindo que os processos e atendimento estejam alinhados aos procedimentos internos, check list e em conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Controlar as operações de cartão e qualidade cadastral, mediante acompanhamento e treinamento da equipe nos procedimentos de indicação, captação, atendimento, pesquisa, registros, análises de documentos para envio a mesa de crédito, bem como emissão e validação dos termos de adesão junto aos clientes após aprovação.
  • Buscar a melhoria de produtividade do setor, através do monitoramento hora a hora dos resultados das vendas de produtos e serviços financeiros, ativação de cartões, venda com juros e parcelado, executando atividades, revendo e remanejando a distribuição de tarefas das equipes, fazendo ajustes, elaborando campanhas e verificando oportunidades com o gerente para garantir o alcance das metas.
  • Garantir a organização, fechamento e supervisão dos caixas, contagem e conferência de numerários, assegurando o lançamento das informações no sistema de retaguarda.
  • Analisar os resultados e curva de vendas hora a hora, através dos sistemas de retaguarda e avantisys afim de estabelecer planos de reversão e ponto de alerta com a equipe com base nas informações coletadas.
  • Garantir que as políticas e normas de abertura de crédito sejam cumpridas, de acordo com a determinação da operadora de cartão, a fim de resguardar a empresa e assegurar a padronização dos processos.
  • Acompanhar a concorrência, através de visitas, observando campanhas, vitrines, fila no caixa, preço, sinalizando o gerente sobre as ações identificadas.
  • Manter a equipe treinada, motivada e devidamente uniformizada, mediante reuniões, orientações nos processos e procedimentos de atendimento.
  • Realizar o desenvolvimento da equipe de líderes, através da aplicação de treinamentos, bem como pelo acompanhamento e definição do plano de ação para o desempenho individual e movimentações.

Requirements and skills

title: Experienced Uvm Verification Engineer
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages:
    VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least:
    be committed to customers’ satisfaction.
What we offer you
  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.
Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

Are you interested in the position?

Contribuir para o sucesso do setor de marcenaria.

Ambição:
Criar um ecossistema completo para ser o one-stop shop do mundo da marcenaria, resolvendo necessidades de forma simples e criando espaços mais belos e funcionais.

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management;
we need someone who candevelop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:

- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:

- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:

- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:

- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:

- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field;
MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.
